headline: Higher sales and operating profit
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 23.82T, up 8.9% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 781.9B, up 13.5% y/y, for an operating margin of 3.3%.
summary_long: Revenue was flat against the prior quarter. Net income of KRW 663.3B compares with KRW 385.2B a year ago and KRW 668.0B last quarter. EPS was KRW 3,698 against KRW 2,138. Operating profit is as reported in the company's preliminary results coverage. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Operating profit and margin come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage; revenue and net income are Yahoo shard values. Shard operating income (KRW 5.8T) does not match the reported figure and is not used.
